color.note: One light theme: the admin lives inside WP Admin, which has no dark mode. The editor stage and the shopper's player use the studio tokens, which are dark by design.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel, table and card. Sits beside WP Admin's own grey without clashing.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, dialogs, inputs and the editor's side panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control tracks, shortcode chips, count pills, empty media. Never put a bordered control on it (line-strong drops below 3:1 here).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows, list rows and menu items on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel and card edges, table row dividers, section rules. When it edges a clickable card, the card's own text and its line-strong hover edge carry the affordance; inputs never use it.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, the off toggle track and secondary buttons, on surface or canvas (3.3:1 and 3.0:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-sunken, brand-soft and the soft status tints. Also the active nav pill and the bulk-action bar fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, help text, metadata, table headers and inactive tabs, on canvas, surface, surface-sunken, surface-hover and brand-soft (5.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder icons only. Not for readable text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (active nav pill, bulk bar, toast).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected states, links, the focus ring, progress and chart bars. As text, on canvas, surface, surface-hover and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons; brand text that must sit on brand-soft at small sizes.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected option cards, the active editor step, chart-bar tracks, info notices. Text on it is ink, ink-muted or brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-strong fill (6.5:1 and 10:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in descriptions and notices. An alias of brand.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The live accent: view counts, the unsaved-changes dot, sale prices on storefront cards. As text on surface, canvas and spark-soft. Never on a button: it would read as destructive.

tokens.name: spark-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind spark text (the 'Unsaved changes' pill).

tokens.name: spark-bright
tokens.usage: Spark on dark: view counts and sale prices on studio and studio-raised.

tokens.name: studio
tokens.usage: The widget editor's preview stage and the shopper's fullscreen player backdrop.

tokens.name: studio-raised
tokens.usage: Controls and toolbars sitting on studio: the device switch track, stage toolbar.

tokens.name: studio-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on studio, and the active item of the device switch.

tokens.name: studio-line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls on studio (3.7:1).

tokens.name: on-studio
tokens.usage: Text and icons on studio, studio-raised and studio-line.

tokens.name: on-studio-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive icons on studio and studio-raised (7.6:1 and 6.4:1).

tokens.name: focus-studio
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour on studio and ink fills, where brand would vanish.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons ('Saved', 'In stock', a finished onboarding step) on surface, canvas and ok-soft. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text: success notices and badges.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons ('Out of stock', 'WooCommerce is off') on surface, canvas and warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, validation errors and the data-deletion setting. As text on surface, canvas and danger-soft. Always with a verb: 'Delete widget', never a bare icon in red.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: error notices, the delete dialog's icon disc.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: reel-scrim
tokens.usage: Storefront: the darkest stop of the bottom gradient that keeps overlay titles legible on any video frame. Merchants can change it per widget.

tokens.name: reel-badge
tokens.usage: Storefront: fill of the view-count pill and the player's icon buttons over video.

tokens.name: on-reel
tokens.usage: Storefront: text and icons laid over video (on reel-scrim or reel-badge).

tokens.name: reel-glass
tokens.usage: Storefront: the product card laid over a reel. Text on it is ink, ink-muted and spark.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Inter, tight and light, for a quiet, minimal look. Page titles, the wordmark and the numbers people come to read. Nothing smaller than display-sm.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one headline on a first-run or empty screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: Widgets, Reels, Settings, a widget's Statistics.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Totals in the metric band. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: The wordmark and the editor's widget name.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter for everything people read and operate.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Setting names, list-row titles, editor sub-sections.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each reel can appear in as many widgets as you like.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, nav items, the name cell of a table row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, segmented-control items.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Counted after one second of playback.
styles.usage: Help text under fields, metadata lines, metric hints.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, view counts, the version tag, timestamps.

spacing.note: 4px base. Panels pad with space-5, cards with space-4, page gutters are space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field; between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and list-row padding; gap in reel grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Editor panel padding; dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between setting rows; metric band cell padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters; between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a page title; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of a first-run hero.

radius.note: Radius follows hierarchy: the smaller the thing, the tighter the corner. Reels get their own radius so a video always reads as a video.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, colour swatches, product thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented items, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, cards, popovers, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and the editor's device frame.

tokens.name: radius-reel
tokens.usage: Every 9:16 reel: storefront tiles, library cards, previews. Merchants can change it per widget.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, nav pills, view-count pills, filter chips.

shadow.note: Resting surfaces use a line, not a shadow. Shadows mean 'this floats'.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The raised thumb of a segmented control or toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the toast, the bulk-action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-reel
tokens.usage: Storefront reel tiles and the editor's device frame.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on light grounds: a 2px surface gap, then 2px of solid brand (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).

tokens.name: focus-ring-studio
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on studio and ink fills.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layouts are built on.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons in rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The Save button in the editor header and first-run actions.

tokens.name: appbar-height
tokens.usage: The ProductReels app bar under the WP admin bar.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The editor's step rail.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: The editor's settings panel.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of list and settings pages.
